name: Blackout: Revival [FREE ZOMBIES]
desc:
Welcome to Blackout: Revival
This is your hub, the gateway to two distinct operations in a world hanging by a thread. Choose, gear up, and push back against the collapse.

Final Eclipse
A class-based roguelite survival mode where you build strength each run and face endless waves of corruption.

Killzone [EARLY ACCESS]
A dynamic looter shooter set in a fractured world ruled by factions and shifting power. Scavenge what you can, adapt to changing conditions, and complete high-risk tasks across an evolving battlefield.
(Join the group for an extra 10 stash capacity in Killzone)
